text:
Lina: Pine & Co. invoice PINE-2026-317 is 35 days past due. Amount $12,300. ACH declined 2026-03-12 (code:R04). Need decision: two-pay plan or escalate.
Marco: Customer messaged sales — they can do 2 payments over 45 days but ask we remove the 1.5% monthly interest.
Dana: Small account, long-standing. Id accept 2 payments if we get a card on file plus a signed acknowledgement. Restrict new seats until first payment clears.
Lina: Snapshot:
```
Invoice: PINE-2026-317
Amount: $12,300
Issued: 2026-02-01
Due: 2026-02-28
Failed ACH: 2026-03-12 (R04)
```
Proposed: 50% ($6,150) due 2026-04-10, remaining 50% due 2026-05-25. No permanent waiver of interest; waive accrued interest on first installment only if payment 1 clears by 2026-04-10. Require card token + signed ACK.
Marco: They prefer a short email to sign. Can Legal produce a 1-paragraph addendum?
Legal: Will draft a one-paragraph payment addendum noting schedule, conditional interest waiver, ACH/card authorization, and remedies on default.
Dana: Approve with conditions. Collections-bot: set reminder 7 days before each due date and escalate if payment not posted within 3 business days.
collections-bot: Reminder created for PINE-2026-317. Automated dunning emails scheduled starting 2026-03-30.
